questions.prompt: Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs. Construct the line through P perpendicular to line ℓ. (P is on ℓ.)
questions.prompt_markup:
Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs.
Construct the line through P perpendicular to line ℓ. (P is on ℓ.)
questions.correct_answer: Arcs centered at P mark A and B on ℓ equally far from P; then construct the perpendicular bisector of AB, which passes through P.
questions.grading_note: Grade the construction marks, not only the final figure: the two equal marks on ℓ and the perpendicular bisector arcs, with the line drawn through P.

questions.prompt: Write the steps for constructing the perpendicular from a point P not on line ℓ.
questions.prompt_markup: Write the steps for constructing the perpendicular from a point P not on line ℓ.
